property_summary: For any admissible initialization parameters, initialize stores changeFee exactly equal to the supplied _changeFee; the mutant stores _changeFee+1, so c.changeFee() != _changeFee for any fuzzed value (e.g. 0).
change_summary: Replace the changeFee assignment with an increment of _changeFee by one, so changeFee stores _changeFee + 1.
